text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Certificate of HSK level 6 Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6.Photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 7.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 8.Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.
